dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (日医標準レセプトソフト); compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux; uses COPY with REPLACING using // delimiters, LINKAGE SECTION with COMMAND-PARAM, and ORCSJOB subprogram calls typical of the ORCA system

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (レセプト) software - monthly disease name/diagnosis replacement processing for inpatient/outpatient receipts
purpose.summary: This batch program (ORCR0900) is part of the JMA ORCA medical receipt system. It reads a receipt detail file (RECE83), transforms disease-name/diagnosis records applying a conversion flag (SYS-2005-TENKIHENKBN), and writes the results to a new receipt detail file (RECE831). It also handles job-management step control and cancellation via the ORCSJOB subprogram.

notable_features: 15 COPY statements with REPLACING using // delimiter
12 CALL statements including ORCSJOB job-management subprogram
LINKAGE SECTION with COMMAND-PARAM for shell parameter passing
INDEXED file I/O with SEQUENTIAL and DYNAMIC access modes
Job step management (STS/CHK/JBE modes via ORCSJOB)
Japanese EUC-JP encoded comments (decoded as latin-1 garbled)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
verdict.notes: File decoded with latin-1 but comments are actually EUC-JP encoded Japanese text, appearing garbled. Source is truncated at 16000 chars (~29% of file). The // REPLACING delimiter and overall structure are characteristic of GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL as used in the JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt system.
